versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the GitHub Issue Resolver agent.
- Automates the GitHub issue resolution workflow: discover, analyze, plan, fix, test, and submit PRs.
- Implements a 5-layer guardrail system to prevent scope creep, unauthorized access, and dangerous operations.
- Strictly enforces one-issue-at-a-time, approval gates for all critical actions, comprehensive logging, and never touches protected branches or sensitive files.
- Includes utility scripts for safe execution, auditing, and guardrail checks, with detailed workflow documentation.
